brand.name: TERRYTORY AI
brand.hero_subtitle: Model releases, research breakthroughs, and industry moves — and what they actually mean for builders and businesses.

editorial.publication_description: an accessible, consumer-friendly publication covering the latest AI tools, practical applications, and major industry news, focused on what matters to everyday users and beginners.
rating_criteria: Mainstream Appeal (1-10): Is this story interesting and understandable to a general audience, beginners, or everyday consumers? (Favor consumer apps, new products, and practical tools over dry academic research.)
Practical Value (1-10): Does this tell the reader how a new tool or update affects them directly? (e.g., new Anthropic tools, cool startup apps).
Clarity & Buzz (1-10): Is the topic trending, highly readable, and free of dense academic jargon?
editorial.research_focus: consumer AI products, practical tools, interesting startup launches, exciting updates from major players (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google), and relatable use-cases. Avoid complex research papers, benchmarks, and dense technical deep-dives.
editorial.image_style: Prefer: friendly, approachable technology in everyday use, clean and bright aesthetics, user-interfaces on laptops or phones, human-centric interactions with AI. Avoid overly dark or abstract technical imagery.
